Function Documentation

bool is_tailscale_host (const char * address)

Determine whether an address belongs to the local Tailscale tailnet. A fully-qualified .ts.net name is accepted directly. Literal IP addresses are reverse-resolved, while short hostnames are forward-resolved and then reverse-checked. The resolved name must end in .ts.net.
